en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large industrial complex in a semi-rural setting. In the foreground is an unpaved road and a field of crops or grass. The main structure is a multi‑story factory building with many tall rectangular windows, attached on the left to a more ornate, villa‑like administrative building with a steep, complex roof, dormers, and a tower-like corner with curved lines suggestive of Art Nouveau or early 20th‑century Central European architecture. To the right stand three tall smokestacks, two plain and one with a decorative band near the top, emitting smoke. Additional brick factory buildings are visible behind them. There are no people or vehicles in view, and the setting appears to be on the outskirts of a town with low hills or trees in the far background.
